recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. Further edits for this DSTU2 clarification would be redundant; any future alignment between summary-table wording and later expansion-focused terminology wording should be handled under the later terminology issues.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive with Modification issue asked to clarify the Binding Strengths table so required binding did not imply all codes in a CodeableConcept must come from the value set. The approved resolution changed the summary to say the concept in the element SHALL be from the specified value set, aligned the other binding-strength summaries, and added a note that exact conformance criteria vary by datatype in the paragraphs below.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git-svn revision 11142, represented by commit 6b65dcb852b1857ee0741ffe138026c24d58b47f, which updated source/terminologies/bindings.xml for required and extensible binding descriptions and added the datatype-specific conformance note to source/terminologies.html. FHIR-12951 later removed a duplicate binding-strength table and fixed punctuation while retaining the note.
additional_context: The current source has been refactored since the DSTU2 application. source/fhir.ini maps resourceType to the terminologies page, and source/terminologies.html now has an explicit Binding Strengths table with the required summary using the approved concept wording, an extensible summary with matching concept wording, and the note that required/extensible conformance criteria vary by datatype. Later terminology decisions such as FHIR-27144 refined detailed required-binding expansion semantics without restoring the original ambiguous plural table text.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build source already conveys the FHIR-12444 clarification and the Required Binding Strength section still states the CodeableConcept rule that one Coding value SHALL be from the specified value set.
